title: Supabase table created without Row Level Security
ask: Can anyone with the public anon key read or write every row of this table?
fix: ALTER TABLE <name> ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; then add policies like USING (auth.uid() = user_id).

title: Supabase service_role key used in browser code
ask: Does browser code get the service_role key, which bypasses all RLS?
fix: Only use the anon key in the browser. Use service_role in server code only, and rotate the key if it shipped.

title: RLS policy that allows everything
ask: Does this policy let any user read or change every row?
fix: Scope the policy to the owner, e.g. USING (auth.uid() = user_id).
